jobs.title: Data analyst (H/F)
jobs.description:
Role Overview
The Data Analyst (H/F) is responsible for transforming complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support strategic planning and operational improvement. This role involves gathering data from various sources, performing detailed analyses, and presenting findings to stakeholders across the organization. The Data Analyst ensures data accuracy, builds reporting tools, and contributes to the development of data-driven solutions. This position is ideal for analytical professionals who enjoy problem-solving, critical thinking, and working with diverse teams.
Key Responsibilities
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple systems and databases to ensure high-quality datasets.
• Perform exploratory and advanced analyses to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
• Design and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and visualization tools for internal teams.
• Collaborate with departments such as marketing, operations, finance, and product to understand analytical needs.
• Support performance tracking by monitoring KPIs and providing regular updates.
• Translate complex analytical results into clear, understandable insights for decision-makers.
• Assist in the development of forecasting models and analytical methodologies.
• Document data processes, standards, and definitions to strengthen data governance.
• Conduct quality checks on datasets and recommend improvements for data integrity.
• Stay informed about emerging tools, techniques, and best practices in analytics.
Qualifications and Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline.
• 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
• Proficiency with analytical tools such as SQL, Excel, Python, or R.
• Experience working with visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
• Strong understanding of analytical methods, statistical concepts, and data modeling.
• High attention to detail with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
• Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills for cross-functional teamwork.
• Proactive mindset with a desire to learn, improve processes, and contribute to data-driven culture.
Summary
The Data Analyst (H/F) plays a vital role in enabling informed decision-making across the organization. By analyzing data, developing meaningful insights, and collaborating with key stakeholders, this role supports growth, efficiency, and strategic direction. It is well-suited for analytical and detail-oriented professionals committed to delivering accurate and impactful insights.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
This role is for a Junior Data Analyst responsible for supporting data-driven decision-making through data collection, analysis, validation, and reporting. In this position, you will assist in transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support business operations, performance monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources, helping to clean, organize, and prepare data for analysis. You will support senior analysts or cross-functional teams by performing structured analyses, identifying basic trends and patterns, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Key responsibilities include maintaining datasets, performing data validation checks, and assisting with routine analytical tasks. You will help generate reports, dashboards, and summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will collaborate with teams across departments to understand data requirements, support reporting needs, and contribute to ongoing analytics projects. This role provides exposure to real-world data workflows, business metrics, and analytical processes, making it ideal for individuals looking to develop foundational data analysis skills.
The Junior Data Analyst role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow data standards, document assumptions, and ensure that outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with business objectives.
Clear communication skills are important, as you will assist in explaining data findings and supporting informed decision-making. By providing reliable analytical support, the Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in enabling data-driven insights and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns
Validate data accuracy and consistency
Maintain and update datasets and data documentation
Assist in creating reports, dashboards, and summaries
Support ad-hoc data requests and routine analytical tasks
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders on data requirements
Document methodologies, assumptions, and data sources
Support performance tracking and operational reporting
Follow data quality and governance standards

Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to work with structured datasets
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic analysis tools
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and metrics
Ability to create clear reports and summaries
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Analyst to support data collection, analysis, reporting, and business insights. The Junior Data Analyst will work with different teams to organize data, identify trends, and help improve decision-making through accurate and meaningful analysis.

Key responsibilities include collecting, cleaning, and validating data from various sources, preparing reports and dashboards, performing basic data analysis, and identifying patterns or opportunities for improvement. The role will support senior analysts and business teams by providing reliable data insights and maintaining accurate documentation of analytical processes.

The Junior Data Analyst will also assist with data quality checks, report automation, performance tracking, and the improvement of data processes. This position requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to work with large amounts of information in a structured way.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or above in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts, reporting methods, and data visualization techniques.
Experience with Excel, spreadsheets, databases, or data analysis tools.
Familiarity with SQL, data querying, and data management concepts is preferred.
Knowledge of visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms is an advantage.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify data inconsistencies and errors.
Good problem-solving and analytical skills with a logical approach to tasks.
Ability to organize information, manage priorities, and meet deadlines.
Strong teamwork skills and the ability to collaborate with different departments.
Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and analytical methods.
The ideal candidate is a proactive and growth-oriented data professional who enjoys working with information, solving problems, and using data to support business improvements.

jobs.description:
About The Company

HackerEarth is a leading technology company dedicated to fostering innovation through its comprehensive platform for coding challenges, hackathons, and technical assessments. With a focus on empowering developers, recruiters, and organizations worldwide, HackerEarth provides cutting-edge solutions that facilitate skill assessment, talent acquisition, and collaborative problem-solving. The company's commitment to technological advancement and community engagement has established it as a trusted partner for companies seeking to build high-performing technical teams and for developers eager to showcase their skills in a competitive environment.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented Data Analyst with strong proficiency in Python and exposure to Generative AI tools to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be instrumental in analyzing complex datasets, automating data workflows, and generating actionable insights to support various business functions. Your expertise will help streamline data processes, enhance reporting capabilities, and leverage advanced AI tools to uncover new opportunities for growth and efficiency. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of data science and artificial intelligence, contributing to innovative projects that shape the future of talent assessment and development.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.
Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role, preferably within the technology or HR tech sectors.
Strong proficiency in Python, including libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools and APIs, such as GPT-based models, for data analysis and automation.
Familiarity with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Matplotlib.
Experience working with large datasets, building data pipelines, and implementing ETL processes.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business decisions.
Develop and maintain data pipelines to ensure efficient data collection, processing, and storage.
Leverage Generative AI tools and APIs to automate routine data analysis tasks and generate reports.
Create compelling data visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings to stakeholders clearly and effectively.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and business units to understand data requirements and deliver actionable insights.
Implement best practices for data quality, security, and compliance across all projects.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and data analytics to continuously improve processes and tools.

Benefits

HackerEarth offers a competitive salary package along with comprehensive health insurance, paid time off, and flexible working arrangements. Employees have access to ongoing learning and development programs, including training on the latest AI and data analysis tools. The company fosters a collaborative and innovative work environment, encouraging employees to contribute ideas and grow their careers. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work on impactful projects that leverage cutting-edge AI technologies, making a tangible difference in the way organizations assess and develop talent.

Equal Opportunity

HackerEarth is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to providing an equitable workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join our team.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Stellantis is a global leader in the automotive industry, renowned for its innovative approach to mobility solutions and commitment to sustainability. With a diverse portfolio of brands and a focus on technological advancement, Stellantis strives to deliver exceptional value to its customers worldwide. The company fosters a dynamic and inclusive work environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. As part of its strategic growth, Stellantis is dedicated to leveraging data and digital transformation to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.

About The Role

The Data Analyst / Front‑End App Developer at Stellantis plays a pivotal role in transforming complex purchasing data into actionable insights through the development of intuitive dashboards and data applications. Working closely with the Data & AI Product Owner, this role involves designing, building, and maintaining analytics tools that support decision-making processes across various departments. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of technical expertise in data analysis and front-end development, with a focus on delivering user-friendly interfaces that facilitate efficient data consumption. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to Stellantis's digital initiatives, ensuring that data-driven insights are accessible, accurate, and impactful for business stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
Proven experience in data analysis, visualization, and front-end application development.
Strong proficiency in data visualization tools and programming languages such as SQL, Python, JavaScript, and relevant frameworks like React or Angular.
Experience with data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.
Knowledge of data management, validation, and quality assurance practices.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and front-end data applications that meet product requirements and business needs.
Implement interactive views, filters, and user-friendly interfaces within established standards to enhance data accessibility.
Ensure the clarity, accuracy, and consistency of analytics outputs, aligning with defined business metrics and definitions.
Analyze purchasing data to identify trends, anomalies, and insights that support strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with the Data Manager and Product Owner to validate data correctness and resolve data discrepancies.
Support root-cause analysis by surfacing data patterns and anomalies for troubleshooting and process improvements.
Translate product requirements into functional analytics solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Assist in testing, validation, and deployment of new data products and updates to existing applications.
Maintain documentation of development processes, data models, and user guides to facilitate ongoing support and enhancements.

Benefits

Stellantis offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees also have access to ongoing training and development programs, fostering continuous learning and career advancement. Additionally, Stellantis provides a collaborative and innovative work environment, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects within the automotive and mobility sectors.

Equal Opportunity

Stellantis is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances innovation and drives our success, and we are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared goals.

jobs.description:
Rebar Project Coordinator

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized professional to join our team in York, PA. This position offers an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in rebar detailing, project coordination, and DOT-related construction projects. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting project execution, customer coordination, and fabrication scheduling while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Duties:

Prepare and coordinate rebar placing drawings and related drafting activities.
Manage project schedules to align customer requirements with fabrication timelines.
Communicate with contractors to address concerns, resolve issues, and implement corrective actions as needed.
Support DOT-related projects, including material certifications and compliance with rebar regulations and specifications.
Coordinate project information between internal teams, customers, and contractors.
Monitor project progress and help ensure deadlines are met.
Maintain accurate project documentation and correspondence.

Requirements:

Understanding of the fundamentals of drafting and coordinating rebar placing drawings.
Knowledge of DOT project requirements, including material certifications and rebar-related regulations.
Knowledge of ASA software is preferred.
Familiarity with DOT blueprint styles is preferred.

Position Details:

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Location: In Office

Note: Qualified candidates will be contacted within 2 business days of application. If an applicant does not meet the above criteria, we will keep your resume on file for future opportunities and may contact you for further discussion.
